career_ladder.note: Gramin Dak Sevaks (BPM, ABPM, Dak Sevak) are holders of civil posts outside the regular civil service, governed by GDS (Conduct and Engagement) Rules. They are eligible for absorption and promotion into the regular Department of Posts cadre through Limited Departmental Competitive Examinations (LDCE) and seniority quotas.

exam_scheme.note: Engagement of Gramin Dak Sevaks is 100% merit-based with no written examination or viva-voce. A system-generated merit list is compiled solely on the basis of 10th standard (Secondary School Examination) marks, followed by Document Verification and Pre-engagement Formalities.

papers.qualifying_threshold: Merit-based cutoff (grades/marks normalized to percentage with multiplication factor 9.5 where applicable)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Satisfactory verification by Divisional Head / designated verifying authority

financial_package.note: Gramin Dak Sevaks receive remuneration in the form of Time Related Continuity Allowance (TRCA) based on the recommendations of the Kamlesh Chandra Committee. Minimum entry TRCA is ₹12,000 for Branch Postmaster (Level 1 / 4 hours) and ₹10,000 for Assistant Branch Postmaster / Dak Sevak, supplemented by Central DA at canonical 58% as of 2025-07-01 and role-specific allowances.
financial_package.pay_level: TRCA Level 1 (₹12,000 – ₹29,380 for BPM; ₹10,000 – ₹24,470 for ABPM/Dak Sevak)
financial_package.pay_source_label: Department of Posts OM No. 17-31/2016-GDS and Model Notification Para 3
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry TRCA of ₹12,000 (BPM Level 1) with 58% Dearness Allowance (₹6,960), Composite Allowance (₹500 for standard premises), Office Maintenance Allowance (₹100), Cycle Maintenance Allowance (₹180 for delivery work), and Stationery Allowance (₹25), less voluntary Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (SDBS ₹300) and GDS Group Insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance on TRCA aligned with Central Government DA orders
Composite Allowance for providing Branch Post Office accommodation (up to ₹500/month)
Office Maintenance Allowance (OMA) and Stationery Allowance
Cycle Maintenance Allowance (CMA) for delivery staff
Service Discharge Benefit Scheme (SDBS) contributory pension with matching Department contribution
GDS Group Insurance Scheme (GIS) and Gratuity up to ₹1,50,000 on completion of qualifying engagement
Severance amount upon discharge and 20 days paid leave per annum
